subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR's current-attempt replay metadata field and server-error retry-before-failover behavior be accepted as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877?
rationale: The code shape is plausible, but it changes retry behavior across session state, message delivery, provider failure routing, and an SDK-exported harness result type; automation cannot choose that compatibility boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Accept after proof and rebase
options.body: Require a clean merge head plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then continue review on this PR.

options.title: Choose a sibling fix path
options.body: Use another open candidate such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97966 as the canonical branch if maintainers prefer its smaller surface or proof story.

options.title: Request a different contract
options.body: Ask for a different current-attempt side-effect signal if maintainers do not want to expose a new optional EmbeddedRunAttemptResult field.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and rebase
recommendation.body: Require a clean merge head plus redacted full-runner or gateway proof showing retry recovery and no duplicate side effects, then continue review on this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and authored adjacent retry-boundary work and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for this session/message-delivery decision.
